scope: local RV64 dual-issue OoO RTL, testbench oracle and evidence-binding defects with high diagnosis or replay cost

depth_contract.VD0: Historical symptom or root-cause narrative only; no executable current-workspace observation.
depth_contract.VD1: A current positive regression or static witness exists, but the historical failure mode is not recreated and dynamically rejected.
depth_contract.VD2: A focused current-design reproduction and fixed positive case exist with raw local observations, but no compile-success negative RTL or oracle version is bound.
depth_contract.VD3: Current-design raw cycle or transaction observations reject a compile-success negative RTL/oracle version and bind stable local artifacts.
depth_contract.VD4: VD3 plus current-design aggregate or frozen-system replay, explicit publication boundaries and independent review.

entries.title: queue-head CSR waits on a younger SQ entry and forms a liveness cycle
entries.historical_symptom: The queue-head CSR remains inflight with mem_quiet low while a younger store remains resident in the Store Queue, so neither the CSR nor the younger store can retire.
entries.root_cause: The historical intermediate RTL required mem_idle and mem_retire_quiet for queue-head CSR retirement; mem_retire_quiet included sq_empty even though the resident SQ entry was younger than the CSR and could only be flushed after the CSR retired.
depth_basis: The product-top raw scoreboard observes three committed and two selectively killed queue-head CSR births with lane1_fire=0; the memory-order case also proves older-store drain and younger-lane refetch after C1.

The backend-only directed state counts one CSR dispatch, one younger STORE dispatch, one SQ allocation, one successful probe request/response, one exact STORE owner and zero physical writes in assertions-on and assertions-off modes.
Current owner-lifetime RTL intentionally keeps mem_idle=0 for that backend-only state; it is recorded as a current guard rather than misreported as queue-head progress.
A root-cone-equivalent historical transport-idle source reaches exactly one CSR C0/C1 and quiet C2 with zero younger STORE writes in both assertion configurations.

Adding the historical mem_idle-and-mem_retire_quiet dependency compiles successfully in both assertion configurations and is rejected only at the dedicated bounded marker with mem_idle=1, mem_retire_quiet=0, hold=1, SQ count=1 and owner-live count=1.

Runner v2 retains each raw Icarus image receipt but binds the summary to allocator-normalized VVP identities; two identical full replays produced a byte-identical summary while semantic-content unit tests remained fail-sensitive.
Production OooIntBackend bytes and the 146-file design-id remain unchanged at sha256:04c5458ff274b7b30e0629fc20ccef4ffa958dee3b80595ee4b46faf17a73897.
required_backfill: Reopen if queue-head CSR packet single-dispatch, head0_csr_inflight frontend hold, SQ owner lifetime, mem_idle, mem_retire_quiet or OooRob mem_quiet wiring changes.
Reopen if the deterministic reconstruction anchors stop being unique or either assertions-on/off historical cycle version is no longer compile-success and dynamically rejected.

entries.title: queue-head CSR stop ownership drops before its inflight lifetime ends
entries.historical_symptom: The pre-T3U queue-head CSR could leave the fetch head without a complete inflight stop owner: the frontend reopened before the older CSR reached C0 and a younger lane1 CSR entered the pending path. The original history attributed the state drop to ordinary drain; the current-topology reconstruction instead observes orphan owner cleanup with drain=0.
entries.root_cause: The historical owner cone lacked both the OooStopPendingSequencer head0_csr_inflight state hold and the OooFrontendRunGate head0_csr_inflight owner-to-busy term. Without the RunGate term, stop_pending is interpreted as orphan and can_run reopens; without the state hold, the orphan clear also drops stop before C0.
depth_basis: A product-topology program creates the older queue-head CSR at PC 0x80000010 and the younger lane1 CSR at PC 0x8000001c through real frontend and control-plane transactions; the raw scoreboard does not force owner, stop, inflight, capture or commit signals.

Current RTL in assertions-on and assertions-off modes observes six inflight hold cycles, zero orphan owner gap, zero stop drop, zero inflight can_run and zero younger lane1 overlap, with two exact C0 commits, two C1 applies and two quiet C2 observations.

Deleting only the sequencer inflight hold compiles and survives this bounded trace because the current RunGate inflight owner prevents orphan cleanup; this is recorded as a successor-contract witness and not as a production deletion or PPA qualification.

Deleting only the RunGate inflight owner compiles in both assertion configurations and is rejected with two orphan/busy gaps, two inflight can_run cycles and one real younger lane1 CSR capture while stop remains one.

The combined historical-pre-T3U root-cone-equivalent version compiles in both assertion configurations. Assertions-on triggers the existing T3U/V9X owner checks; assertions-off reaches one stop drop, two inflight can_run cycles and one real younger lane1 CSR capture.
All eight variants compile successfully and use the same raw product-topology scoreboard without event deduplication. Existing assertions remain present and are not weakened to collect later events.

The current topology has ordinary_drain_root=0 because backend_drained requires ROB empty while the queue-head CSR is inflight; the causal record therefore distinguishes the historical drain narrative from the observed orphan-clear root.

A full replay produced byte-identical summary and case logs plus stable allocator-normalized VVP identities. The focused runner/oracle unit tests pass 7/7, related V9O and standalone tests pass with assertions on/off, and the assertion-on module aggregate passes 113/113.
Production OooStopPendingSequencer and OooFrontendRunGate bytes remain unchanged and the 146-file design-id remains sha256:04c5458ff274b7b30e0629fc20ccef4ffa958dee3b80595ee4b46faf17a73897.
required_backfill: Reopen if queue-head CSR birth/inflight/C0/C1/C2, stop sequencer priority, RunGate owner/orphan/busy mapping, pending lane1 capture or drain ROB-empty semantics change.
Reopen if either assertions-on/off historical-pre-T3U version no longer compiles or the raw scoreboard no longer rejects owner gap, premature can_run and real younger lane1 capture.

Exact historical-source or VD4 claims require a separately bound historical snapshot plus aggregate/design-id independent review; this VD3 record does not qualify formal, full-system, architecture-stable, synthesis, STA or PPA conclusions.

entries.title: simulation exit terminalizes while a memory owner is still active
entries.historical_symptom: pending_exit could reach raw exit and latch halted status after ROB/issue drain even when the exact memory owner had not terminalized.
entries.root_cause: The drain-complete equation historically applied mem_owner_terminalized only to pending SYSTEM and architectural trap, not to pending exit.
depth_basis: Assertions-on/off focused terminal tests pass 5/5 in each mode.
Seven compile-success RTL negative versions are dynamically rejected.
Production RTL applicability is hash-bound to the current design and relevant stages are present in the 26-stage replay.
The SERIALIZE-G1 independent review retained the trap/exit non-claim boundary.
required_backfill: Reopen if the pending exit holder, exact memory terminal equation, trap/exit priority or output latch RTL changes.

entries.title: dmesg checker classifies printk debug text as a BUG token
entries.historical_symptom: A completed 5,071,521,696-cycle system transaction publishes FAIL because the checker matches the BUG substring inside printk debug text.
entries.root_cause: The historical case-insensitive expression used an unbounded BUG: alternative instead of requiring a non-identifier boundary.
depth_basis: The immutable A3 publication remains FAIL while execution and oracle states are separated.
Frozen console replay accepts printk debug text and rejects a real BUG token with 3/3 positive/negative unit cases.
An independent review approved only the system-transaction-complete and legacy-oracle-invalid classification.
required_backfill: Reopen if the production dmesg expression, frozen A3 console, checker identity or A3 publication state changes.

entries.title: procedural force/release leaves a stale holder value and hides a missing transient owner
entries.historical_symptom: Removing the EX1 transient-owner union remained green because a previously forced procedural variable retained its value after release and masked the missing holder.
entries.root_cause: Four transient probes reused one ProducerId and relied on release to restore a procedural variable before the next procedural assignment.
depth_basis: The fixed test uses distinct ProducerIds and crosses reset after each release.
Nine compile-success transient-owner RTL negative versions are dynamically rejected and canonical source pre/post hashes are stable.
The evidence is focused and independently reviewed but is not promoted to a current full-system claim.
required_backfill: Reopen if the transient holder probe reuses a ProducerId, omits the reset boundary or stops checking compile-success negative versions.
